digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM config resolver / config sources
propositions: Add REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a TOML file whose keys layer over (not replace) the discovered config.
Precedence is CLI -c > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default.
Nested tables must deep-merge (leaf key wins) while arrays replace wholesale rather than append, including empty-array meaning no fallbacks.
The env var must be read as a string literal os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") so the static AST scanner documents it and the CI drift gate stays idempotent.
A pointer to a nonexistent file must fail loudly with a typed rebar config error naming the variable.
Deep merge must live in the llm resolver only; read_reserved_section's shallow update must remain unchanged to avoid mis-scope.
